items.what: set_crs must also update the crs attribute of the spatial_partitions GeoSeries (not just keep the geometries)
items.quote:
assert new.spatial_partitions.crs is not None
assert CRS.from_user_input(new.spatial_partitions.crs) == CRS.from_user_input(new_crs)

items.what: set_crs must also work on dask GeoSeries objects, preserving spatial partitions there too
items.quote:
dask_obj = dask_geopandas.from_geopandas(geoseries_points, npartitions=2) ... new = dask_obj.set_crs("EPSG:4326")
assert new.spatial_partitions is not None

reason: The instruction only shows preservation of spatial_partitions on a GeoDataFrame; the tests additionally require the spatial_partitions' own crs attribute to be updated and the fix to apply to GeoSeries — both are mechanical propagation of the same change to siblings, so guessable.
